technology: HB_DRAM_on_Logic; timing/state surrogate, not Stratum reproduction
prediction_scope: Conditional architecture model; no claim of independent device calibration

logic_peak_tflops.basis: Nominal throughput; topology rounding difference retained

logic_compute_pj_flop.basis: 0.604 pJ/MAC divided by two FLOP/MAC; MAC coefficient only

dram_background_w.basis: Background/refresh proxy is not inferred from the 104 W account

access_energy_pj_byte.basis: Use reported aggregate scale as full-row access anchor; not independent device calibration

activation_share.basis: ACT+PRE partition; sum preserves the chosen full-row access energy scale

logic_memory_share.basis: Logic-side low-voltage peripheral/HB share; remainder on memory side

replicated_periphery_fraction.basis: Replicable portion of reported LV peripheral area

periphery_static_w_mm2.basis: Area-scaled standby penalty, common to all designs

extra_path_dynamic_fraction.basis: Conservative additional switching/routing overhead on logic-side memory energy

tFAW_ns.basis: Borrow standard HBM3 24 CK x0.625ns for each assumed independent ACT domain

tRRD_ns.basis: Borrow HBM3 nRRDS=4 CK x0.625ns; scope is an explicit exploration assumption

read_latency_ns.basis: Conservative analytic transaction occupancy; command latency measured separately

hb_chip_tb_s.basis: Fixed data connections; internal interface budget, not external HBM DQ

hb_data_connections.basis: 1 Gb/s max per data connection yields 32 TB/s

hb_control_power_connections.basis: Reserve control and power pads, common to all designs

hb_pitch_um.basis: Dense HB grid budget, not a manufactured Stratum padmap

package_top_resistance_k_w.basis: Assumed effective liquid-cooled top resistance; HotSpot microfluidic htc=27132 W/m2/K gives 0.305 K/W at 121 mm2. Not a reproduced package.

bond_areal_resistance_mm2_k_w.basis: Order-of-magnitude hybrid Cu/dielectric interface resistance, sensitivity retained

cooling_gradient.basis: Fixed lateral boundary variation, same cooling for every organization

execution_assumptions.mapping: channel=output row mod 16; bank interleaving across all local banks; both designs use same policy
execution_assumptions.inputs: Idealized common input broadcast, equal for all designs
execution_assumptions.scheduling: Same FRFCFS RowHit/Open policy; same 64 outstanding requests per tile budget
execution_assumptions.dvfs: Idealized continuous time sharing of common discrete DVFS points
execution_assumptions.thermal: 4x4 two active equivalent layers plus spreader; not eight separate DRAM dies
execution_assumptions.known_technique_baseline: segmented_2 is FGDRAM/SALP-inspired domain partitioning, not a new mechanism or full reproduction

thermal_geometry.basis: TIM/lid scale from official HotSpot template; equivalent active-layer thicknesses are assumptions, not Mono3D geometry.
